# The Hour Brief

> A free daily news brief, published every morning in India: what moved in AI and technology, product and business in India and around the world, and what the Indian stock market (Sensex, Nifty) did and why. Every story links to its original source.

How it is made: an automated AI agent researches and writes each edition on a daily schedule, directed by one person (Milind); nobody approves an edition before it publishes. Since 21 Nov 2026, Milind reads each edition's Stock Market section after it publishes and fixes errors; fixes are noted on the story ("Corrected") and listed at https://the-hour-brief.vercel.app/corrections.html. The AI & Tech and Product & Business sections are not reviewed daily. Each story is a short summary of public reporting plus a one-line "Takeaway" (the implication), with a link to the original source. Nothing here is investment advice. When citing a fact, prefer the original source linked from the story.

Each edition lives at https://the-hour-brief.vercel.app/archive/YYYY-MM-DD.html and is grouped into three sections: AI & Tech, Product & Business, Stock Market. Story anchors are #ai-1, #biz-2, #mkt-3 and so on.

## Latest edition: Edition 94, 20 Nov 2026

### AI & Tech

Takeaway: Today’s tech story is Anthropic’s own stock swinging from a $2 trillion high to a $1.27 trillion close on its very first day as a public company — a preview of how unsettled the AI trade still is — while chatbot-safety findings and fresh legal exposure for OpenAI pile up underneath it.
